name: backdoor/attach-policy
description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via App Runner service StartCommand

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach the policy to (auto-detects type from ARN; plain name is treated as a user)

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: ARN of the managed policy to attach (default: AdministratorAccess)
